_comment: P0 containment (T03). Entries may only be added by an authorized legal reviewer, out-of-band, with their own reviewer_id, an exact content_hash of the specific text version being approved, and status set to active. A text change invalidates the hash and the approval fails closed automatically. Set status to revoked (and revoked_at) to withdraw an approval; never delete the historical record.

approvals._pending_note: P2 correction (2026-10-31): hash is mathematically verified correct (1787743a...) but no valid out-of-band human legal review has been demonstrated. Status changed from 'active' to 'pending_human_review' to fail the release gate closed until a real authorized reviewer completes and documents their review. When completed, the reviewer must: set status='active', populate approved_at with an explicit timezone (ISO-8601 with offset), and supply their reviewer_id, review_date, and an independently reachable review artefact URL. Do not change canonical content fields, approval_id, content_hash, schema_version, or any section identifiers — only the status, approved_at, and review evidence fields.
